question: Kapil and Prakash together can do a piece of work in 45 days. Prakash and Pihu together can do it in 60 days. Kapil and Pihu together can do it in 60 days. In how many days will Kapil, Prakash and Pihu finish it together?
solution:
**Given:**

Kapil and Prakash together can do the work in 45 days.

Prakash and Pihu together can do it in 60 days.

Kapil and Pihu together can do it in 60 days.

**Concept:**

Total work = Time × Efficiency
